Agentic Security Open Workshop
Agentic Security Open Workshop
Livestream Event from RSAC 2025
About
Join us for a dynamic, community-driven workshop exploring the emerging discipline of Agentic Security through the work of the OWASP GenAI Security’s Agentic Security Initiative (ASI).
This open workshop will be live streamed and is designed as a live conversation with the community to discuss our work through the lens and real-life workflows of builders, defenders, and decision makers. You’ll hear directly from the OWASP ASI team about our ASI taxonomy, defining threats and mitigations and how to utilise them in threat modelling agentic systems with using novel modelling approaches, such as MAESTRO.
Preview and discuss our forthcoming Securing Agentic Apps guidelines with best practices to help you architect, develop, and deploy secure agentic apps. We will preview our forthcoming Agentic Security Landscape work and a discussing of what’s happening in the area of fast emerging Agentic Security covering frameworks, tooling, products, compliance and governance issues and anything that can affect securing agentic spps.
